SELECT * FROM( select row_number() over() as rownum, vfp.finprod_id finprodId, /*资产代码*/ vfp.finprod_market_id bondid, /*债券代码*/ vfp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, /*债券简称*/ vfp.finprod_name finprodName, /*债券名称*/ vfp.issue_price price, /*发行价格*/ (vfp.issue_amt)/100000000 sumprice, /*发行总额*/ vfp.ccy ccy, /*币种*/ fpt.type_1 bondtype, /*债券分类*/ fpt.type_1 bondtypeCode, vfp.bln_area blnArea, /*境内外*/ vfp.trade_market tradingplace, /*交易场所*/ mci.CALENDAR_ID tradingtime, /*交易日历*/ vfp.Issuer issuer, /*发行人*/ to_char(vfp.vdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate1, /*起息日*/ to_char(vfp.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate1, /*到期日*/ vfp.is_sus isSus, /*永续*/ vfp.is_right isRight, /*是否含权债*/ vfp.exe_date exeDate , /*含权债摊销日设置*/
vfp.coupon_species couponType, /*息票品种*/ vfp.coupon_species couponTypeCode, vccr.basis basis, /*计息基础*/ vccr.calc_type ratetype, /*利率类型*/ (vccr.yield)*100 ratestr, /*初始利率*/
vcpr.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, /*截止日营业日准则*/ vcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, /*支付日营业日准则*/ vcpr.pay_cycle paycycle, /*付息频率*/ vcpr.calc_rule calcrule, /*推算方式*/ decode(vcpr.calc_rule,'03',to_char(vcpr.first_pay_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'),'') fpayDate /*首次付息日*/ from FIN_PRODUCT vfp
left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on vfp.finprod_id = fci.finprod_id
left join ( SELECT R.CASH_ID,R.FINPROD_ID,R.FINPROD_TYPE,R.EFF_DATE,R.BASIS,R.CALC_TYPE,R.YIELD, row_number() over (PARTITION BY R.CASH_ID ORDER BY R.EFF_DATE ASC) as newResult FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R ) vccr on fci.CASH_ID = vccr.CASH_ID AND vccr.newResult =1
left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE vcpr on fci.cash_id = vcpr.cash_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on vfp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO mci on mci.CALENDAR_ID = vfp.CALENDAR_ID where 1 = 1 and vfp.finprod_type = 'F01' and fci.cash_type_1 = '02' AND vfp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} ORDER BY vcpr.Eff_Date desc ) WHERE rownum=1

select fep.exercise_status xqstate, /*行权状态*/ TO_CHAR(fep.vdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') applydatestr, /*行权申请开始日*/ TO_CHAR(fep.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') applydateend, /*行权申请结束日*/ decode(fep.exercise_type,'01','赎回','02','回售') xqmode, /*行权方式*/ TO_CHAR(fep.EXERCISE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') exerciseDate, /*行权日*/ fep.exercise_price xqnetprice, /*行权净价*/ fep.exercise_remark xqclause /*行权条款*/ from fin_exercise_plan fep left join fin_product fp on fep.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id =#{finprodId}
select to_char(fccr.eff_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') efdate, (fccr.yield)*100 rate2 from fin_cash_calc_rule fccr left join fin_product fp on fccr.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}

select to_char(fcp.vdate_term,'yyyy-MM-dd') theorydatestr, /*理论开始日*/ to_char(fcp.mdate_term,'yyyy-MM-dd') theorydateend, /*理论结束日*/ to_char(fcp.vdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') actdatestr, /*实际计息开始日*/ to_char(fcp.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') actdateend, /*实际计息结束日*/ to_char(fcp.pay_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') plandate, /*计划支付日*/ fcp.INT_AMT planintamt /*计划支付利息*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '02' order by theorydatestr

select fp.vdate vdate1, to_char(fcp.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') jsdateend, /*计息截止日*/ to_char(fcp.pay_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') paydate, /*支付日*/ /*(fcp.prin_amt)/100 remoney*/ /*还本面额/百元*/ fcp.prin_amt remoney /*还本面额/百元*/ from FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fcp.cash_id = fci.cash_id left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId} and fci.cash_type_1 = '01' order by jsdateend

select to_char(fcp.vdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') jsdatestr, /*计息开始日*/ to_char(fcp.mdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') jsdateend, /*计息截止日*/ to_char(fcp.pay_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') paydate, /*支付日*/ to_char('')*100 qjrate, /*区间利率*/ /*(fcp.prin_amt)/100 remoney,*/ fcp.prin_amt remoney, /*还本面额/百元*/ fcp.int_prin_amt jxamt, /*计息本金*/ (fcp.int_amt) yjint, /*应计利息/百元*/ fcp.cash_amt cashflow /*现金流*/ from fin_cash_plan fcp left join fin_product fp on fcp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id where fp.finprod_id=#{finprodId} order by jsdatestr
